Row.Text: Annotates the Victories screen so you can see who is about to trigger a victory countdown, and why. A civ's score turns red once it already clears the goal the next victory tier will set — that civ starts a countdown the moment the Point Goal drops. Hovering a victory column adds, to each tier section, the Point Goal that tier produces and the arithmetic behind it (for example "Point Goal 240 = x1.5 of 2nd place 160"), plus a note naming the civ whose countdown it would start. Everything is exact arithmetic on current standings, read live from the game database — there are no projections or estimates. UI only: it never changes the rules, and it is safe to add to or remove from a save at any time.
